Package aor.proj3t.entities

Class User

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.entities.User
@Entity public class User extends Object
Entity representing a user in the system. Users are the main actors in the application and can have different roles such as employees, managers, or administrators. They have hierarchical relationships through manager-employee associations and belong to workplaces.
